blocks.text: Spyware ek harmful (nuqsan pohanchane wala) software hai jo chupke se dekhta rehta hai ke aap apne computer ya phone par kya kar rahe hain.

Misal: Agar aap kisi unreliable (jis par bharosa na kiya ja sake) jagah se muft app download karein to woh aap ke device par spyware install kar sakti hai. Yeh spyware aap ko bataye baghair aap ki online activities (kaam) ko monitor karta hai (chupke se dekhta rehta hai), jaise aap kaunsi websites dekhte hain ya kya maloomat type karte hain.

blocks.prompt: MCQ 3: Kaunsa harmful software chupke se aap ke computer ya phone ki activities ko chupke se monitor karta hai?
blocks.explanation: (c) Spyware. (Kitab ki answer key yahan (a) Spam deti hai, jo ghalat hai; spam unwanted messages hain, software nahi.)

items: Spyware: chupke se monitor karne wala harmful software; aksar unreliable jagah ki muft apps se aata hai.
